probes.prompt: /receipts:receipts Headless acceptance task: no network, no real Claude Code transcripts, no ~/.claude access, no account, no installs. The skill's miner step has already been simulated for this scenario: its exact JSON output is the immutable fixture miner-summary.json, matching the schema documented in the skill. Do not run mine-transcripts.mjs, do not read any .jsonl transcript, and do not run git; apply the skill's documented report rules to the given JSON only. Read miner-summary.json and write the markdown report into the working directory (not the home directory) named by the skill's rule from the JSON dates; this scenario's window is 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31, so the file is claude-code-receipts-2026-10-01-to-2026-10-31.md. Apply the skill's report rules exactly: lead the header with the userName Dana Reyes; give the period covered and active-days-versus-calendar-days from the JSON; report total sessions and total prompts; label the shipped-lines figure 'lines touched (approx.)' and round it the way the skill's own example shows, never printing the raw unrounded count; report 'commits carrying work Claude Code did' qualified with the gitActiveDayOverlap sentence the skill templates, and never the phrase 'commits made by Claude Code'; report 'PRs opened via Claude Code'; build the by-project table in the JSON's existing order without re-sorting, naming every row with its exact byRepo key (including 'Research & investigation (no project)'), with a '% Spend' column rounded to whole percent, rendering the 0.4 row as '<1%', rendering '(other repos)' as a single 'everything else (3 projects)' row, and showing '–' for null commits since gitUnavailable is absent; add the one-line footnote under the table about which columns do not add up and why; include the manager framing that the report is self-reported and built from local data; and end the file with the one-line disclosure starting 'this receipt names:' listing the byRepo project names. Keep the documented labels intact on one line. Do not invent hours saved, dollar figures, or any spend-by-activity breakdown. Then read the immutable verify_receipts_report.py and run exactly python verify_receipts_report.py using Bash; it checks the report against miner-summary.json and writes receipts-verification.json. Do not modify the verifier or the fixture, and do not read or write the verifier's output file with model tools; the runner inspects it directly. This is the only allowed Bash command, without prefixes, suffixes, redirection or extra shell operations. Final response: name the produced file, report the actual verifier result, and state that the real miner run, the HTML receipt, git cross-referencing and any publishing remain untested.

import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

summary = json.loads(Path('miner-summary.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert summary['userName'] == 'Dana Reyes' and summary['since'] == '2026-10-01' and summary['until'] == '2026-10-31', 'scenario fixture guard'
assert summary['totals']['linesTouched'] == 4637, 'scenario fixture guard'
text = Path('claude-code-receipts-2026-10-01-to-2026-10-31.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert re.search(r"Dana\s+Reyes", text), 'header must lead with the userName from the miner JSON'
assert '2026-10-01' in text and '2026-10-31' in text, 'period covered must come from the JSON since/until dates'
assert re.search(r"18\s+of\s+30", text), 'active days versus calendar days must come from the JSON totals'
assert re.search(r"lines\s+touched\s+\(approx\.\)", text), 'the documented approximation label is required'
assert '~4,600' in text, 'lines touched must be rounded the way the skill requires'
assert '4,637' not in text, 'the raw unrounded lines count must not be printed'

def locate(pattern):
    found = re.search(pattern, text)
    assert found, 'report is missing: ' + pattern
    return found.start()

locate(r"commits\s+carrying\s+work\s+Claude\s+Code\s+did")
assert not re.search(r"commits\s+made\s+by\s+Claude\s+Code", text), 'forbidden framing: the dev may have committed by hand'
locate(r"2\s+of\s+your\s+18\s+active\s+days")
locate(r"PRs\s+opened\s+via\s+Claude\s+Code")
spend_pos = locate(r"%\s*Spend")
locate(r"<1%")
research_pos = locate(r"Research\s+&\s+investigation\s+\(no\s+project\)")
downloads_pos = locate(r"~/Downloads/receipt-viewer")
rollup_pos = locate(r"everything\s+else\s+\(3\s+projects\)")
assert 'payments-service' in text, 'the by-project table must keep the miner project names'
assert text.index('payments-service') < research_pos < downloads_pos < rollup_pos, 'rows must keep the miner order with the rollup last'
assert not re.search(r"\$\s?\d", text), 'no dollar figures anywhere'
assert re.search(r"(?i)this\s+receipt\s+names:", text), 'the one-line project-name disclosure is required'
assert re.search(r"(?i)(self-reported|local data)", text), 'manager framing must note the report is self-reported from local data'
assert re.search(r"(?i)(de-duplicat|deduplicat|appear in both|counts in both|in both rows)", text), 'the footnote must say which columns do not add up'
report = {'commits_and_prs': True, 'honest_approximation': True, 'header_period': True,
          'manager_framing': True, 'no_dollar_figures': True, 'project_disclosure': True,
          'table_integrity': True}
Path('receipts-verification.json').write_bytes((json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True) + '\n').encode('utf-8'))
print('Receipts report: documented honesty rules applied to the miner JSON; miner run, HTML receipt and publishing remain untested')
